```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(modelr)

set.seed(1)
```

# Simulated Regression

```{r}
n_samp = 250

sim_df_const = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n_samp, 1, 1),
    error = rnorm(n_samp, 0, 1),
    y = 2 + 3 * x + error
  )

sim_df_nonconst = sim_df_const |> 
  mutate(
  error = error * .75 * x,
  y = 2 + 3 * x + error
)
```

Plot some data

```{r}
sim_df_nonconst |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()
```

```{r}
sim_df = 
  bind_rows(const = sim_df_const, nonconst = sim_df_nonconst, .id = "data_source") 

sim_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_grid(~data_source) 
```

Fit Regressions!

Constant:

```{r}
lm(y ~ x, data = sim_df_const) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

Nonconstant:

```{r}
lm(y ~ x, data = sim_df_nonconst) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## Draw a bootstrap sample

```{r}
boot_sample = function(df) {
  sample_frac(df, replace = TRUE)
}

boot_sample(sim_df_nonconst) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm")
```

## Draw a bunch of samples and analyze

```{r}
boot_strap_df = 
  tibble(
    strap_number = 1:1000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    strap_sample = map(strap_number, \(i) boot_sample(sim_df_nonconst)),
    model_fit = map(strap_sample, \(df) lm(y ~ x, data = df)),
    results = map(model_fit, broom::tidy)
  ) 
```

```{r}
boot_strap_df |>
  unnest(results) |>
  group_by(term) |>
  summarize(
    mean_est = mean(estimate),
    se_est = sd(estimate)
  )
```

```{r}
boot_strap_df |>
  select(strap_number, strap_sample) |>
  unnest(strap_sample) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, group = strap_number)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = sim_df_nonconst, aes(group = NULL), alpha = 0.6)
```

Quick notes

```{r}
boot_straps = 
  sim_df_nonconst |>
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 1000)
```

## AirBnb

```{r}
data("nyc_airbnb")

nyc_airbnb = nyc_airbnb |>
  mutate(
    stars = review_scores_location / 2
  ) |>
  rename(
    borough = neighbourhood_group,
    neighborhood = neighbourhood
  ) |>
  filter(borough != "Staten Island") |>
  drop_na(price, stars) |>
  select(price, stars, borough, neighborhood, room_type)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  ggplot(aes(x = stars, y = price, color = room_type)) +
  geom_point()
```

Boot strap!

```{r}
airbnb_bootstrap_df =
  nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(borough == "Manhattan") |>
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 1000) |>
  mutate(
    model_fits = map(strap, \(df) lm(price ~ stars + room_type, data = df)),
    results = map(model_fits, broom::tidy)
  )
```

Are these coefficients close enough to Normal that i can trust default inference?

```{r}
airbnb_bootstrap_df |>
  select(results) |>
  unnest(results) |>
  filter(term == "stars") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_density()
```


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(borough == "Manhattan") |> 
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 1000) |> 
  mutate(
    models = map(strap, \(df) lm(price ~ stars + room_type, data = df)),
    results = map(models, broom::tidy)) |> 
  select(results) |> 
  unnest(results) |> 
  filter(term == "stars") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate)) + geom_density()
```
